studies.title: ARCH–LSTM Structural Equivalence with Hybrid Student-t Likelihood Loss for Financial Volatility Forecasting
studies.previous_decision: no_recuperado; secciones indexadas y código parcial
studies.decision_reason: Nueva lectura continua del cuerpo editorial HTML verifica BTC/ETH, target epsilon², LSTM recurrente y evaluación un paso. Admisible como evidencia aplicada narrativa; no acredita sigma7 ni dominancia general.

access.source_version: Current publisher HTML, publication 2026-09-04; version-history endpoint returned 429

data.frequency: daily closing prices / daily log returns

target.construct: conditional variance, scored against squared centered daily returns
target.formula: r_t = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); epsilon_t = r_t - mu_hat_train; y_t = epsilon_t²; forecast sigma_hat_t² from lagged epsilon²
target.scale: variance in squared decimal daily log-return units; figures use logarithmic axes

architecture.proposed: one recurrent LSTM layer; final hidden state; dropout; dense positive variance output with softplus; dense batch normalization stated
architecture.units_reporting_conflict: §2.3 says one cell; same section offers tuner widths 16/32/64/128. The fitted width is not resolved by these passages.
architecture.source_role_limit: Applied study supports its own LSTM/TCN/Transformer experiment; does not replace foundational architecture sources of the E2 catalogue.

split_and_training.validation: taken from end of training segment
split_and_training.optimizer: Adam; cosine learning-rate decay; gradient clipping 1.0
split_and_training.hpo_method: Keras Tuner named; exact search algorithm/trial budget not resolved
split_and_training.cost_scope: §3.3 describes final ten-seed runs under fixed configuration, excluding a separate HPO phase; not an equal total search-cost comparison.

reported_results.source: Table 7, complete rows read in editorial HTML
reported_results.metric: percent change of OOS loss relative to GARCH(1,1); negative is lower loss
reported_results.interpretation: Metric dependence is material: proposed model improves BTC MSE but worsens BTC MAE versus GARCH. No universal neural-family winner.
reported_results.sensitivity: §4.6.2 ARCH-restricted experiment: best activated likelihood worsens BTC QLIKE 1.5%, improves ETH 4.1%. This is a separate experiment and not a general effect of the unrestricted proposed model.
reported_results.tests: DM on QLIKE with Newey–West HAC and within-market Holm–Bonferroni; TOST margin ±2% QLIKE; Kupiec/Christoffersen VaR and Acerbi–Szekely ES tests
reported_results.test_interpretation_limit: §4.4/§5.2 describe mostly non-significant differences versus strong GARCH and DL rivals. §4.3/§5.2 report a BTC advantage for CNN-LSTM. QLIKE DM markers must not be represented as separate MSE/MAE significance tests.
reported_results.risk_backtest_summary: §4.7: adequate reported crypto/equity tail coverage; Gold and Oil failures constrain generality. No comparative VaR/ES superiority test against all baselines.

code.historical_code_note: Prior static review verifies separate TCN/LSTM builders; its log-variance output differs from the current prose's softplus variance output. Reconciliation remains unverified.

leakage_and_fairness.positive_reporting: chronology, tail validation, no shuffle and training-only centering explicitly stated
limits: Best out-of-sample lambda sensitivity is exploratory; do not treat it as an untouched confirmatory test or independent HPO result.
Fitted width, validation fraction, comparator seed budgets, refit schedule and scaler scope remain unresolved.
The body and Table 6 caption alternate epsilon², |epsilon|, and variance rather than standard deviation in residual standardization; retain formula/reporting uncertainty.
Equation (3) uses nu-2 whereas (8) uses nu in the Student-t scale; claimed exact likelihood equivalence is not independently validated.
Equation (5) lacks the recurring GARCH intercept omega; an initial condition alone does not establish the stated exact equivalence. This is reviewer mathematical analysis, not a replication result.
Data counts, provider snapshot and claimed common endpoint have not been reconciled against an archived dataset.

studies.remaining_requirement: Eligibility and narrative results can be closed. Exact reproducibility and full numerical DM/table audit remain open; no sigma7 comparison or pooling.
